def solve(inp):
    h=len(inp); w=len(inp[0])
    seq=[x for x in inp[-1] if x]; L=len(seq)
    sset=set(seq)
    # mark = isolated single nonzero in rows above (its value appears once in seq)
    g=[row[:] for row in inp]
    for i in range(h-2,-1,-1):
        for j,x in enumerate(row:=inp[i]):
            if x==0 or x not in sset or j>=L-1: continue
            idx=seq.index(x)
            # extend rightward: start at j-idx? demo1 row2: mark 2 idx0 at j=7 -> fill 7..12 with idx0 at j? out row2 cols7-12 = 2,3,5,1,6,4 so idx0 AT j. 
            # demo5: mark 1 idx3 at j=2 -> out row5 cols0-4 = 3,5,1,6,4: idx3 AT j=2? cols0..4 values 3,5,1,6,4: 1 at col2 = idx3 ✓ so pattern occupies cols j-idx..j+L-1-idx, i.e. same as before with seq[(k-start)%L], start=j-idx.
            start=j-idx
            for k in range(max(0,start),min(w,start+L)):
                g[i][k]=seq[(k-start)%L]
    return g
print('d1',solve(G['Demo pair 1 input'])==G['Demo pair 1 output'])
print('d2',solve(G['Demo pair 2 input'])==G['Demo pair 2 output'])
